item.text:
Document QnA is not limited to PDFs. It can answer questions about images such as PNG and JPG, using OCR to extract their text and structure. Mistral’s OCR documentation lists PNG and JPEG/JPG as supported `image_url` formats. [OCR Processor documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr#document-formats)

For questions about broader visual content—not just text in the image—send the image as an `image_url` or Base64 image to a vision-capable model through Chat Completions. [Vision documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/vision#sending-an-image)

The Document QnA examples focus on PDFs, but Mistral’s cookbook explicitly describes discussing PDFs, photos, and screenshots. [Document QnA cookbook](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/cookbooks/mistral-ocr-document_understanding)
